name: ELLLO
description_short: Over 3,000 free listening lessons of natural conversation across five CEFR levels, most with audio or video, a transcript, and an interactive quiz — pick one and use it live mid-lesson.
teacher_note: Fast to pull up something on-topic mid-lesson — pick a level and topic, and the transcript is right there if a student gets stuck.
creator: ELLLO
internal_notes: Verified live: free, no login required for lessons, quizzes, and transcripts. cefr_level set specific A1-C1 since the site organises all 3000+ lessons by these five bands site-wide, a sourced structural claim rather than a guess. group_fit/teaching_use scope left minimal since this is a broad browsable library, not one activity — same treatment as iSLCollective.
